_source.why: Mol* ships no language layer: every label in its panel reaches the DOM in English, and the bundle is a vendored release neither this repository nor the operator may edit. The workspace writes Chinese over what it drew, keyed by that English text. This file pins the wording so the Chinese for it can be tested. It is not the contract: the bundle and the viewer pages are.
_source.repository: ScienceVision -- the viewer runtime an operator registers per batch, which this repository serves but does not deliver
_source.how: Loaded viewer/molstar.html?embed=expert against a PDB (4HHB) and a COD CIF (1501802), opened the controls panel, and read every visible text node, title and aria-label under .msp-plugin. Wording both structures show is the panel's own; wording only one shows is listed as structure_data. Controls that need further clicks, and the pages' own chrome, were added by hand and confirmed against the bundle's and the pages' literals. The two lists are disjoint: a string kept as panel vocabulary is not also listed as structure data, because no key may name what a structure supplies.
_source.limits: Measurement labels Mol* draws into the WebGL scene are not DOM text and cannot be reached this way; its deeper parameter panels hold several hundred more strings, which stay English because a string with no wording is left exactly as it was drawn.
